Yeah, it's not too hard. The toughest two are the "500km" trophy and the "all items" trophy. However, the 500km trophy actually is given to you around 70km. AND, you have to do the distance on the same set of tires. when you go to the tire section of the garage, selecting a tire will show you the distance traveled on the set. If you really want this trophy but don't want to wait, the best thing to do is go into a 2 local player exhibition game, tie the game by the end and let it go to overtime, then just rubber band the controller so throttle is down and the car turns in circles. Then, you can go do errands, or go to sleep, or whatever. Come back in a few hours and you should have the trophy. But that is cheating I guess, so you might lose some trophy cred. if you tell anyone.

The all items trophy is a grind. You get one item win or lose each match. So, you will need to play 160 or so rounds to get that trophy.
